Values: One of {``reference``, ``limited``, ``open``}; ``null`` only valid with ``dataset: atlite``
Description: NREL reV access scenario applied as availability weighting to GODEEEP capacity factors. Required non-null when ``renewable: dataset: godeeep`` — the schema and the workflow both raise otherwise. ``reference`` is NREL's central land-access assumption (the default); ``limited`` is the most restrictive; ``open`` is the most permissive (sensitivity studies). Selects the avail/caps file pair downloaded from Zenodo.

If true, overlay the California Energy Commission Wind/Solar BaseScreen on the NREL exclusion raster for onwind and solar (CA-only — outside California the variant equals the base). Selects the ``_cec`` file variants. No effect on offshore tech.
If true, overlay the BOEM OSW planning-area screen on the NREL exclusion raster for offwind and offwind_floating. Selects the ``_boem`` file variants. No effect on onshore tech.

Hub-height suffix used to construct the raw GODEEEP wind capacity-factor filename (e.g. ``wind_gen_cf_2030_125m_compressed.nc``). Must match a published Zenodo record (``wind_<height>_<scenario>_compressed``). Ignored for solar.

How GODEEEP cell capacity factors are weighted up to the ``s{simpl}`` cluster bus. ``capacity`` (default): availability-weighted within each substation region, then weighted across the cluster's substations by NREL installable capacity (``p_nom_max``). ``availability``: a single availability-weighted mean over every cell of the cluster (the behaviour before this key existed). Only read when ``renewable: dataset: godeeep``. Note this is deliberately NOT what pypsa-usa ``master`` computes — there the cluster profile is formed in ``simplify_network``, weighting substation ``p_max_pu`` by EXISTING ``p_nom`` and falling back to an unweighted mean where a cluster has no existing capacity.
